questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Let us ______ a meeting to discuss this issue.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'call'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"call"** means to summon or invite someone to attend a meeting or event. (बुलाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager decided to call a meeting to discuss the new project.
 
 
 
• **"Call"** is an appropriate choice in this context because it indicates organizing or arranging a meeting.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'call'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Take **(लेना): To acquire possession, control, or occupancy of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to take a break from work.
 
 
 
• **Voice **(आवाज देना): To express something in words.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to voice his concerns during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Say **(कहना): To utter words so as to convey information, an opinion, a feeling or intention, or an instruction.
 
 
• **Example:** He wanted to say something but remained silent.

questions.question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western qurter.
After anchoring, the wind was varieable and light from the western quarter.
After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western quarter.
After anchoring, the wind was variable and lite from the westen quarter.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western quarter".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"variable"** means something that is not consistent or having a fixed pattern; it can change. (परिवर्तनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The weather in the mountains is highly variable, making it hard to predict.
 
 
 
• **"Quarter"** refers to one of four equal or corresponding parts into which something is or can be divided. (चौथाई)
 
 
• **Example: **The city is divided into four quarters, each with its own unique character.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 3**, all the words are correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: "After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western qurter."

 
 
• **Qurter** (quarter) (चौथाई): The correct spelling is "quarter".
 
• **Example:** He lives in the northern quarter of the city.
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: "After anchoring, the wind was varieable and light from the western quarter."
 
 
• **Varieable** (variable) (परिवर्तनीय): The correct spelling is "variable".
 
• **Example:** The stock market can be highly variable.
 
 
 
• **Option 4**: "After anchoring, the wind was variable and lite from the westen quarter."
 
 
• **Lite** (light) (हल्का): The correct spelling is "light".
 
• **Example:** He prefers lite meals in the evening.
 
• **Westen** (western) (पश्चिमी): The correct spelling is "western".
 
• **Example:** They live in the western part of the country.

questions.question:

options.text: To make a bad situation worse.

questions.solution:

• **Example: **Before submitting the report, make sure to dot the I's and cross the T's.
 
 
 
• **"To do something carefully"** refers to performing a task with great precision and attention to detail. (सावधानीपूर्वक कुछ करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She always does her homework carefully to avoid any mistakes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To do something carefully**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To make a bad situation worse** (खराब स्थिति को और खराब करना): To take actions that exacerbate an already negative situation.

 
 
• **Example:** His careless remarks only made a bad situation worse.
